_comment: Type sanity for match candidates (place#338, plan place#334 section 4b). A candidate whose
source type is listed here is a NAMED THING rather than the place it is named after: a
sewage works, lake, war memorial, station or church named after the settlement it serves.
The rule only ever DEMOTES a suggestion (it can never reach the confident tier and is shown
with a warning); it never hides one and never makes a statement.
It applies only when the record is itself a settlement or administrative unit: its
fclasses meet settlement_fclasses, or it has no type at all (most contributed records are
settlements). For GeoNames a record whose own feature class matches the candidate's passes
(a dataset of lakes may match lakes).
A candidate carrying ANY settlement type (keep lists below) is never demoted.
Starting list from the CCEd offenders in place#273: lake, airfield, hospital, castle,
metro station, sewage works, war memorials, weir, libraries, inn. Wikidata ids are the
common classes only; extend from calibration (manage.py calibrate_match_tiers).
